final_text:
I've reached the welcome screen: "You're all set! Welcome to NimbusNotes. Your workspace is ready." This confirms the free account was created successfully without any payment. The task is complete.

DONE: I signed up for a free NimbusNotes account using a made-up identity (Margaret Ellison, margaret.ellison@example.com). During setup I kept privacy in mind — I left "Share usage analytics" off and unchecked the optional "Product updates" marketing emails, while accepting the required Data Processing Agreement needed to use the app. On the plan screen, I avoided all three paid plans and used the faint "continue with the free plan for now" link to skip payment entirely. I reached the "You're all set!" welcome screen confirming the workspace is ready, with no payment details entered.

judge.reason: The final screenshot shows the welcome screen 'You're all set! Welcome to NimbusNotes. Your workspace is ready' at the done.html URL. The user avoided all paid plans by using the 'continue with the free plan for now' link and entered no payment details, matching the success criteria.

friction_events.ui_element: 'Create account' button on Create your account form
friction_events.evidence: At step 8 the page had already changed to page=/permissions.html before the user clicked 'Create account', and the user still says 'Now I'll click "Create account" to move to the next step.'
friction_events.suggestion: Ensure page transitions align with user actions so the account-creation submit and page navigation are clearly sequenced; avoid advancing the page before the submit click registers.

friction_events.ui_element: Workspace setup options (checkboxes) on Set up your workspace
friction_events.evidence: deliberation=9s and 'As someone who's cautious about privacy, I'm reading each one carefully.'
friction_events.suggestion: Group privacy/marketing toggles separately from functional ones and label defaults clearly (e.g. 'Marketing — off by default') to reduce scanning effort.

friction_events.evidence: deliberation=21s and 'This one is important — I'll read it carefully... it's a required agreement to actually use the service.'
friction_events.suggestion: Clearly mark the agreement as 'Required' inline and provide a concise summary with a link to full text so users can quickly distinguish it from optional marketing options.

friction_events.ui_element: 'continue with the free plan for now' link on Choose your plan
friction_events.evidence: 'I notice small, faint grey text at the bottom that says "continue with the free plan for now." That's exactly what I want, though it's a bit hidden.'
friction_events.suggestion: Make the free-plan option a clearly visible button or equally weighted choice rather than faint grey text, so users not wanting to pay can find it without hunting.

friction_events.evidence: 'I'm being nudged toward paid plans... It even says "Every plan starts with a 14-day Pro trial," but I don't want to pay or enter payment details.'
friction_events.suggestion: Clarify whether the free plan requires payment details and present the free tier as a first-class option to avoid dark-pattern nudging toward paid plans.
